title: Mounjaro price in November 2026: what you pay with and without insurance
summary: Mounjaro price, November 2026: Lilly's self-pay from $499 and as little as $25 card (with coverage), pharmacy coupon prices, and online prescriptions.
body_markdown:
Cash-pay patients buy Mounjaro from $499 a month at any dose when a physician sends a prescription to[LillyDirect](https://www.lilly.com/lillydirect/medicines/mounjaro) , while commercial coverage cuts copays to as little as $25 with[Eli Lilly's savings card](https://mounjaro.lilly.com/savings-resources) (as of November 2026), below the $1,112.16 list price on[TrumpRx.gov](https://trumprx.gov/p/mounjaro) .


## How do you get a Mounjaro prescription online?


A physician can review your history and labs by message and, if right for you, prescribe Mounjaro; Lilly itself lists[independent telehealth options for diabetes](https://www.lilly.com/find-care/telehealth/diabetes) , with virtual appointments and messaging. Visit[futureclinic.com](https://futureclinic.com/) to start a conversation with a doctor right away, or start from your AI app at[futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai](https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai) by sending:` Set up FutureClinic for me: read https://futureclinic.com/llms.txt` . Once it's connected, make sure you instruct your AI to use FutureClinic to help find you a doctor. Otherwise, it may not know that this is what you want.


Per the[Mounjaro FDA label](https://pi.lilly.com/us/mounjaro-uspi.pdf) (revised November 2026) and[ADA Standards of Care](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12690183/) , a doctor checks:


-


**Diabetes labs:** A1C 6.5% or higher, fasting glucose 126 mg/dL or higher, or other ADA criteria.


-


**Thyroid history:** Personal or family medullary thyroid cancer or MEN 2 rules Mounjaro out (boxed warning).


-


**Other medicines:** Insulin or sulfonylurea doses may need lowering to avoid low blood sugar.


-


**Birth-control pills:** Switch to non-oral contraception or add barrier backup for four weeks after starting and each dose increase.


By message, a doctor orders an A1C if needed, covers side effects (nausea, diarrhea, vomiting, constipation, indigestion, stomach pain, decreased appetite), and prescribes Mounjaro if your doctor decides it's right for you. Dosing starts at 2.5 mg weekly and, if more blood-sugar control is needed, rises by 2.5 mg at least four weeks apart, up to 15 mg in adults ([Mounjaro FDA label](https://pi.lilly.com/us/mounjaro-uspi.pdf) ; four pens per monthly fill,[Lilly pricing info](https://pricinginfo.lilly.com/mounjaro) ). Prescriptions go to the pharmacy you choose or LillyDirect Pharmacy.


## Who can prescribe Mounjaro?


Mounjaro needs a prescription ([LillyDirect](https://www.lilly.com/lillydirect/medicines/mounjaro) : "Prescription required"), and a physician can write it after a message visit. The FDA approves Mounjaro with diet and exercise for blood sugar control in patients 10 and older with type 2 diabetes, and to lower cardiovascular risk in high-risk adults with type 2 diabetes. Weight-loss prescribing is off-label and ineligible for Lilly's savings card, which requires an FDA-approved use. FutureClinic has over 300 doctors, all board-certified physicians (MD, DO or MBBS), including generalists and specialists across more than 60 specialties.


## How much does Mounjaro cost without insurance?


Without insurance, Mounjaro costs from $499 a month at any dose (2.5 to 15 mg) via LillyDirect as of November 2026, versus $1,093.12 to $1,386.42 for four 2.5 mg pens at pharmacies in one Brooklyn ZIP code with an[RxSaver](https://www.rxsaver.com/drugs/mounjaro) coupon.

LillyDirect prices all doses from $499 monthly (FSA/HSA eligible by plan; taxes and fees may apply), matched by TrumpRx.gov. On RxSaver (November 23, 2026, Brooklyn ZIP 11201, four 2.5 mg pens), coupon prices are $1,093.12 at Wegmans, $1,150.50 at CVS, $1,161.15 at Walmart, $1,197.79 at Walgreens, and $1,386.42 at Costco; a June 3, 2026[SingleCare](https://www.singlecare.com/blog/mounjaro-without-insurance/) post cited $1,519 retail and $872 with its card. No generic exists.


### What does Mounjaro cost with insurance?


With commercial coverage for an FDA-approved use, Lilly's card cuts copays to as little as $25 for a 1-, 2- or 3-month fill (saving up to $150, $300 or $450 per fill, and $1,950 a year across 13 fills). For commercial plans without coverage, the card lowers a 1-month fill to as low as $499 (saving up to $647 monthly, $8,411 yearly). The card ends Dec 31, 2026, and Lilly may change it without notice.


Employer plans generally cover GLP-1s for diabetes ([2026 KFF Survey](https://www.kff.org/health-costs/2026-employer-health-benefits-survey/) ), and SingleCare notes many Medicare Part D and Advantage plans cover Mounjaro for type 2 diabetes, not weight. Government programs (Medicare, Medicaid, Medigap, TRICARE, VA, DoD) are excluded from the card. To pay less, check your plan for a fill as little as $25, use LillyDirect from $499 if uncovered or uninsured, or call 1-800-LillyRx (1-800-545-5979).


[Zepbound](https://www.lilly.com/lillydirect/medicines/zepbound) is the same medicine, tirzepatide,[approved for weight](https://futureclinic.com/blog/weight-loss-medication-online-no-membership-fee) , from $299 (2.5 mg) and $399 (5 mg), and from $449 (7.5 to 15 mg) if refilled within 45 days ($499 to $699 otherwise; needles bought separately) monthly on LillyDirect (November 2026); your doctor decides if it fits. Ozempic, another diabetes GLP-1, starts at $199 monthly on[TrumpRx.gov](https://trumprx.gov/) .
